title: One-level densities of large even and odd orthogonal families of automorphic L-functions
summary: We prove one-level density results for L-functions attached to primitive forms of level q, averaged over square-free q, conditional on the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH). We treat the even and odd orthogonal families separately and extend the support of the Fourier transform of the test function to (-3,3). This extended support yields the strongest known non-vanishing results for these families of L-functions and their derivatives at the central point, conditional on GRH.
